info.title: Contacts
info.x-hubspot-api-use-case: Retrieve a contact by ID to bring that contact data into your external system.
info.x-hubspot-introduction: Use the contacts API to create and manage contacts.

post.summary: Read contacts by ID or property

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived

post.description: Returns a batch of contact records retrieved by internal ID or unique property values, with partial success indicated by a 207 response.

get.description: Read an Object identified by `{contactId}`. `{contactId}` refers to the internal object ID.  Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived

delete.description: Move an Object identified by `{contactId}` to the recycling bin.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{contactId}`. `{contactId}` refers to the internal object ID. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties result in an error. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

post.summary: Merge two contacts with same type
post.description: Returns the resulting merged contact object after combining two contacts of the same type into a single record.

post.summary: Archive a batch of contacts by ID
post.description: Archives the specified batch of contacts by ID, moving them to the recycling bin. Returns no content on success.
Returns the newly created batch of contact records, with partial success indicated by a 207 response.

post.summary: Update contacts by ID or property
post.description: Returns the updated batch of contact records identified by internal ID or unique property values, with partial success indicated by a 207 response.

Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to follow GDPR. Use optional property 'idProperty' set to 'email' to identify contact by email address. If email address is not found, the email address will be added to a blocklist and prevent it from being used in the future.

get.description: Read a page of contacts. Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived

post.description: Create a contact with the given properties and return a copy of the object, including the ID. Documentation and examples for creating standard contacts is provided.
Create or update records identified by a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object.
Returns a collection of contact records matching the specified search criteria and filters.
